title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
hook: If you liked the party-of-adventurers feeling in Delicious in Dungeon.
description: An elf wizard finishes the big quest, kills the demon king, and goes home. Then her human friends get old and die while she barely ages, and she realizes she never really got to know them. So she sets out again to fix that. Quiet and funny, with fights that come out of nowhere and hit hard.
meta: Season 1 is 28 episodes, season 2 is 10, and season 3 arrives in 2027.

title: Witch Hat Atelier
hook: If you like a magic system with actual rules you could learn.
description: Coco finds out that magic is not something you are born with. It is drawn, like handwriting, and anyone who learns the strokes can do it. Which is exactly why it is kept secret. She gets taken in as an apprentice at a workshop with three other girls who are all better at this than she is. The art is some of the best in any anime.
meta: 13 episodes so far. A second season is being made.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica
hook: If you want to be lied to by a show and then find out.
description: A talking cat-thing offers a middle schooler any wish she wants, as long as she becomes a magical girl and fights monsters. It looks like a bright, cute show for small children. It is not.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
hook: If you want one story that starts strong and actually finishes.
description: Two brothers try to bring their mother back with alchemy. It goes very wrong. One loses an arm and a leg, the other loses his entire body and ends up as a soul bound to a suit of armor. They join the military to find a way to fix it. The magic system has hard rules and the villains have real plans.
meta: 64 episodes, one complete story, no filler.

title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
hook: If you want a mystery where the answer has been locked in the next room the whole time.
description: Yuru is a village kid who hunts for a living, and his twin sister has spent her whole life locked in a cage. Nobody will tell him why. Then strangers arrive who can summon shadow creatures that come in bonded pairs, and it turns out the cage was never there to protect the village from her.
meta: Currently airing, 24 episodes planned. Written by the author of Fullmetal Alchemist.

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
hook: If you like watching someone win with the one skill nobody respects.
description: Will goes to a magic academy where your rank is your worth, and he cannot cast a single spell. What he can do is swing a sword hard enough to make that not matter. He is trying to reach the top of the Wizard's Tower because of a promise he made to a friend years ago.

title: Hunter x Hunter
hook: If you like fights that get won by planning instead of shouting.
description: Gon is 12 and finds out that his father, who he was told was dead, is alive and is a famous Hunter who left to go do Hunter things. So Gon takes the Hunter exam, which turns out to be less of a test and more of a survival event. He makes a best friend who is a trained assassin his own age.
meta: 148 episodes. Starts light and gets much heavier as it goes.

title: MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES
hook: If you liked Sakamoto Days playing ridiculous action completely straight.
description: A magic school where everyone casts spells, except Mash, who has no magic and has instead done an unreasonable number of push-ups. He solves every magical problem by punching it. It is a straight parody of Harry Potter and it commits completely.

title: SPY x FAMILY
hook: If you liked the comedy timing in Sakamoto Days.
description: A spy has to fake having a family for a mission, so he adopts a kid and marries a stranger. What he does not know is that the kid can read minds and the wife is a professional assassin. Nobody tells anybody anything. Anya, the kid, knows all of it and mostly uses her mind reading to get out of homework.

title: WITCH WATCH
hook: If you want a comedy that can switch to serious without warning.
description: Nico is a witch doing her apprenticeship year, which means living with her childhood friend Morihito, who has been assigned to protect her. Her spells almost never do what she intends. From the author of Sket Dance, so the jokes come fast.

title: Shangri-La Frontier
hook: If you like games, speedruns, or figuring out how systems break.
description: Sunraku plays terrible video games on purpose, the buggier the better, because beating garbage is more fun than beating something good. Then he tries a real top-tier VR game and finds out his years of suffering through broken games made him weirdly overpowered.

title: Haikyu!!
hook: Even if you do not care about sports.
description: Volleyball. A short kid who can jump absurdly high teams up with a genius setter who he hates. That is the whole premise and it works. The matches are treated like life or death and the show fully commits to that.

title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
hook: If you liked Delicious in Dungeon and want the low-stakes version.
description: A wizard kingdom summons four heroes and accidentally gets a fifth guy, an ordinary office worker whose only power is online grocery shopping from Japan. He gets thrown out of the palace, cooks himself dinner, and a legendary wolf shows up demanding to be fed. Then a slime. Then a baby dragon.
meta: 12 episodes per season, two seasons. Made by MAPPA, so the food looks absurd.

title: Ranking of Kings
hook: If you liked how Mob Psycho treats a main character everybody underestimates.
description: Prince Bojji is deaf, cannot speak, and is physically the weakest person in the kingdom. Everyone assumes he will be a terrible king. His first real friend is a talking shadow. The art looks like a picture book and the story goes to much darker places than the art suggests.

title: Trigun
hook: If you like a hero whose entire thing is refusing to do the obvious.
description: Vash the Stampede has a 60 billion double dollar bounty on his head and a reputation for flattening entire towns. He is also a cheerful idiot who refuses to kill anyone, ever, and most of the destruction around him is caused by the people chasing him. Desert planet, gunfights, a lot of jokes, and then it stops joking.

title: TRIGUN STAMPEDE
hook: If you like a hero whose entire thing is refusing to do the obvious.
description: Vash the Stampede has a 60 billion double dollar bounty on his head and a reputation for flattening entire towns. He is also a cheerful idiot who refuses to kill anyone, ever, and most of the destruction around him is caused by the people chasing him. Desert planet, gunfights, a lot of jokes, and then it stops joking.
meta: The newer computer-animated version. Shorter and darker than the 1998 original.

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm
hook: If you would rather invent paper than live without books.
description: A girl who loved books dies and wakes up in a fantasy world where books are handmade, absurdly expensive, and only nobles own them. So she decides to invent paper. Then ink. Then printing. It is a fantasy show about building an entire industry from nothing because you want something to read.

title: Yona of the Dawn
hook: If you want a main character who starts out useless and does not stay that way.
description: A sheltered princess watches her father get killed and has to run for her life with one bodyguard. She goes from useless to genuinely dangerous over the course of the show, mostly by learning to shoot a bow and refusing to quit.

title: Kaiju No. 8
hook: If you want monster fights without a long setup.
description: Kafka is 32 and cleans up giant monster corpses for a living, which is the job you get when you fail the defense force exam enough times. Then he gets infected and turns into a monster himself. Now he has to pass the exam while hiding that he is the thing they are supposed to kill.

title: Solo Leveling
hook: If you like watching a character level up and want nothing more complicated than that.
description: In a world where people fight monsters in dungeons for a living, Jinwoo is the weakest hunter alive and everyone knows it. Then he survives something he should not have and starts getting stronger in a way that works like a video game. Very flashy, very satisfying, not very complicated.

title: BOCCHI THE ROCK!
hook: If you liked the visual weirdness in Mob Psycho.
description: Bocchi is a guitarist who practiced alone in her closet for three years and is so anxious she sometimes melts into a puddle on screen, literally. Someone drags her into a band. The animation does whatever it wants whenever she panics, which is often.

title: Nichijou - My Ordinary Life
hook: If you like jokes that go on far longer than they should.
description: Sketch comedy about ordinary school life, except a girl rides a goat to school and a professor builds a robot maid with a wind-up key in her back. The animation quality is wasted on the dumbest possible jokes, deliberately. Watch one episode and you will know immediately.

title: Log Horizon
hook: The smart version of the trapped-in-a-game premise.
description: Thirty thousand players get stuck inside an MMO. Instead of panicking, a strategist named Shiroe decides the real problem is that nobody has built a working society yet, so he starts one. Guild politics, economics, contract law, and a lot of arguing in meeting rooms.

title: BOFURI: I Don’t Want to Get Hurt, so I’ll Max Out My Defense.
hook: The fun version of the trapped-in-a-game premise.
description: Kaede does not want to feel pain in a VR game, so she dumps every stat point into defense and refuses to spend any on anything else. This should make her useless. Instead she accidentally becomes an unkillable monster that the developers cannot balance around.
meta: Full title: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

title: Skip and Loafer
hook: If you want a show where nobody is cruel.
description: A hyper-organized girl from a tiny village starts high school in Tokyo with a life plan mapped out to age 40, and immediately gets lost on the way to the opening ceremony. Gentle, funny, and unusually kind to every character in it.

title: Natsume's Book of Friends
hook: If you want something calm with a bit of sadness in it.
description: Natsume can see spirits, which has made his whole life lonely. He inherits a book of spirit names from his grandmother and starts returning them one at a time. Mostly a series of short, sad, warm stories.

title: Laid-Back Camp
hook: If you want a show with almost no conflict in it at all.
description: Girls go camping. That is the show. They set up tents, cook things over fires, and are cold. Mostly about gear, food, and being outside on purpose in winter.
